findings.text: follow-on: the nearest-label traversal has no time exception, so a time coordinate inherits its parent field's transformation class and is exported as a transformed quantity -- the live jt-60sa magnetics export shows magnetics/b_field_pol_probe/field/time carrying cocos_label one_like from xml (run dir live-magnetics-handoff.json), although a timebase is never COCOS-transformed, so an importer that resolves every labelled row against the source COCOS is handed rows it can never resolve. Section 7's text is followed literally (nearest labelled ancestor), so this is a semantics gap the plan did not settle rather than a violation of it; the reviewed run's own later commit 0a61ff99e adds exactly this time rule, so the coordinator should land the revision carrying that commit.

follow-on: the module defines COCOS_ABSENT = "none" locally, duplicating CocosLabel.NONE = "none" already owned by imas_codex/ids/models.py:245 and read by imas_codex/ids/transforms.py:146, so the absence token now has two sources that can drift; the export should read CocosLabel.NONE rather than mint a second spelling of it.

follow-on: the traversal tests drive a MagicMock whose HAS_PARENT branch reimplements the hop selection itself (start = 0 if "*0.." in statement else 1) and returns one canned row, so the suite asserts the query string carries "*0.." rather than the Cypher ORDER BY target_id, hops ASC plus collect(label)[0] nearest-ancestor idiom or its behaviour against a real graph; a rewrite of the query that kept the "*0.." substring and changed the ordering would leave every assertion green, so the graph-side selection is verified only by the live export, not by the gate.

justifications.fit: the change follows the module's shape -- a small focused helper, the shared SIGNAL_KEYS/check_handoff_document contract extended in place, and additive keys with format_version held at 1 -- but it mints COCOS_ABSENT = "none" locally instead of reading the existing CocosLabel.NONE token, so two spellings of one DD convention now coexist in imas_codex/ids.

justifications.reuse: the diff extends the existing search_existing_mappings path and adds one helper rather than a second resolution mechanism, and it removes the binding's now-unused cocos_label read; the only reuse miss is the duplicated absence constant.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-status 02a98eb0e..1fb670f33 lists only imas_codex/ids/handoff.py, tests/ids/test_mapping_handoff.py, tests/fixtures/mapping_handoff_example.json and the evidence fragment, exactly the declared write paths, with no generated model and nothing outside the fence.
